content:
Dear all,
I am a new contributor to Mathlib4, and I got a lot of great feedback on the improvement of the code in my PR.
Based on the feedback, I improved my code, and added a comment describing the improvements.
However, my PR still has the awaiting author flag. Is this common? Am I, as the author able to remove it?

Thank you for your help
You can type "-awaiting-author" in the PR to remove the tag. This is explained in the guideline https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/index.html

I just commented that, thanks
although it doesnt look like the tag has gone away It is PR #38829
Never mind, it took a minute to update. Thank you!
